LanguageData.RR_Gate_NoNormalWindow: The gate cannot apply a new time cost during its emergency-return window.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_OperatorNotStaffing: The assigned operator is not staffing the console.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_OperatorUnavailable: The assigned operator must be alive, capable, employed, and present on the facility map.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_PowerUnstable: The gate needs stable connected power and a charged return reserve.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_OpeningPowerUnstable: The connected power network cannot support the gate's configured opening load while retaining its required headroom.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_ExpeditionMismatch: The emergency-return request does not match the active expedition.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_NoEmergencyWindow: The gate has no active emergency-return window.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_WarningTenMinutes: The gate opening has about 10 in-game minutes remaining.

LanguageData.RR_Gate_WarningTwoMinutes: The gate opening has about 2 in-game minutes remaining.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_StandingRecallDesc: Order the crew home automatically when this gate's opening has a chosen amount of window left. It only ever tells them to walk back; it never closes the gate and never ends the trip. Off by default.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_StandingRecallInspect: Standing recall: the crew is called home with {0} of window left.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_StandingRecallIssued: Standing recall issued. The crew has been told to return through the gate.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_NotOpen: The gate has no active expedition to interrupt.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_CalibrationUnavailable: The gate is not ready for calibration.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_AlreadyCalibrated: This gate is already calibrated. That step is done.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_OperatorNotEmployed: The assigned operator is not employed staff any more. Assign one who is.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_MachineUnavailable: The gate is no longer available.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_InvalidAssemblyBill: The assembly bill did not target this installation's assigned assembly station.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateAssemblySection: A section of the gate assembly was installed.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateAssemblyCompleted: The gate assembly is complete. Assign a qualified operator and calibrate the gate.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateCalibrationCompleted: The gate calibration is complete. Staff the console and review the power reserve before dispatch.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateOpeningStarted: The gate opening has started. The expedition window is running.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateOpeningClosed: The gate opening is closed. Crew and cargo remain accounted for in the expedition record.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateEmergencyReturnPaid: Emergency return has committed {0} watt-days from the gate's reserve.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateRecoveryOpeningStarted: The recovery opening has started, spending {0} watt-days from the gate's reserve.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_TimeCostWindowExhausted: The recorded route distortion consumed the remaining normal opening. Use the emergency return while it remains available.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_KillSwitchDesc: Choose a power switch on this gate's own circuit as its emergency cutoff. Throwing that switch ends an opening at once and names itself as the cause. Only a switch that actually carries this gate's power can be chosen. If there is none, wire one into the line that feeds the gate and turn it on.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_KillSwitchArmed: Emergency cutoff: {0}, closed and carrying power.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_KillSwitchThrown: Emergency cutoff: {0} is OPEN. The gate has no supply.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_NoKillSwitchCandidates: No power switch on this gate's circuit
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_GateControlDesc: Hand this installation over to the gate. Its ordinary company functions are withdrawn while it does, and on a machining table every bill except the gate assembly is suspended until it returns to normal operation.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_NormalOpDesc: Give this installation back to its ordinary work. The bills gate control suspended are resumed, and the gate will not spin up or be assembled until it is handed over again.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_NotInGateControl: One of the gate's installations is still in normal operation. Set the comms console and the machining table to gate control first.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_MakeLabel: Commission this door as the gate
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_MakeDesc:
Commission this door as the branch's gate.

This only decides which door the gate is. The circuit does not have to exist yet.

If the headquarters already has exactly one comms console, one battery and one machining table, they are bound at the same time. Otherwise the door becomes the gate anyway and you finish the circuit on the Operations gate pane.

The gate still has to be assembled, calibrated and powered before it will open. It will tell you which of those is missing.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_NoSingleConsole: No single comms console to commission against. Build one at the headquarters, or choose between them on the Operations gate pane.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_NoSingleBattery: No single battery to hold the gate's reserve. Build one at the headquarters, or choose between them on the Operations gate pane.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ChooseBench: No single machining table to commission against. Build one at the headquarters, or choose between them on the Operations gate pane.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_DesignatedNeedsCircuit: This door is the gate now. Its circuit is not finished yet: {0}
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_IsRunExtension: This door is part of another gate's run, not a gate of its own. Give the run back from the gate it belongs to first.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateDesignated: This door was commissioned as the branch's gate.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_UnsupportedSwitch: That is not a power switch.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_SwitchMustBeOnToBind: The switch must be closed when it is chosen, so its circuit can be checked against the gate's.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_SwitchNotOnGateCircuit: That switch does not carry this gate's power. Wire it into the line that feeds the gate.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_SwitchAlreadyBound: Another gate already uses that switch as its cutoff.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateKillSwitchBound: An emergency cutoff was set on a gate.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_ServiceFine: Assembly condition: {0} days remaining, wearing at {1}x.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_ServiceWanted: Assembly condition: {0} days remaining, wearing at {1}x. Reconditioning wanted.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_ServiceLapsed: Assembly condition exhausted. The gate will not open until it is reconditioned.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ServiceLapsed: The gate assembly is out of condition and must be reconditioned before it will open.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ServiceNotWanted: The gate assembly does not need reconditioning yet.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpStarted: Bringing up a connection to {0}. The operator must stay on the console until it is open.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpLapsed: The connection lost its charge before it opened. The address is still remembered and can be dialled again.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpAborted: Spin-up stopped. The address is still remembered.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpWaiting: The connection is fully charged and waiting: {0}
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpBusy: This gate is already bringing up a different connection.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpHeldReadout: Charged and waiting to open to {0}.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_AbortSpinUpDesc: Stop bringing up this connection. The work done so far is lost, but the address stays in this gate's history and can be dialled again.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SupplyTooLow: The circuit cannot deliver enough power to start an opening. A charged battery is not supply: the gate needs generators actually running.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_HeadroomTooLow: There is no margin left above what the gate already draws. Add generation, or take something else off this circuit.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_IntegrityTooLow: The gate is too badly damaged to hold a connection. Repair it, then calibrate it again.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_IntegrityLost: The gate came apart under load
LanguageData.RR_Gate_IntegrityReadout: Condition {0} - below the {1} a connection needs. Repair, then calibrate.
LanguageData.RR_Letter_GateIntegrityText:
{0} has taken enough damage to lose its calibration. It is down to {1} condition, and it will not open a connection until it has been repaired and calibrated again.
Repairing it is ordinary construction work. Calibrating it is the assigned operator's job, as it was the first time.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_TooManyGates:
Three gates are already operational. That is the limit: three called addresses plus your colony is four of the five maps the game will hold open at once, and the fifth is the margin for a natural door somebody walks through without planning to.
Stand one of the others down first, or board up a natural door to free a slot.
LanguageData.RR_GateWatch_MildDesc: Leaves as soon as they are hungry or tired, like any other work. The gate drops unless somebody else takes the station.
LanguageData.RR_GateWatch_BalancedDesc: Leaves when urgently hungry or very tired. One step past ordinary work, one step short of harm.
LanguageData.RR_GateWatch_StrictDesc: Stays through hunger and tiredness, and leaves only at the point where staying would injure them. Hold a window open with this, then relieve them.
LanguageData.RR_GateWatch_LeftFloor: left the console before it hurt them
LanguageData.RR_GateWatch_LeftPosture: left the console to see to themselves
LanguageData.RR_Egress_HostileText:
{0} reached {1} while it was open and went through it.
They are on the other side now, and they came for what you keep there. Closing the gate does not bring them back, and it does not bring your people back either.
LanguageData.RR_Egress_FriendlyText:
{0} walked through {1} while it was open.
They were not invited and nobody sent them. Whatever happens to them in there happened on your watch.
LanguageData.RR_Egress_NotEligible: That one cannot cross on its own legs.
LanguageData.RR_Egress_PrisonerLabel: A prisoner went through the gate
LanguageData.RR_Egress_PrisonerText:
{0} walked through {1} while it was open.
They are still your prisoner and still in your custody; nothing about crossing changed that. They will look for a prison bed on the other side, and a warden can cross to feed them.
If you did not mean to send them, the zoning and the door are what decide it.
LanguageData.RR_Egress_InYourCustody: That one is in your custody. Prisoners, slaves and guests do not walk through a gate; somebody has to carry them.
LanguageData.RR_Egress_NoOpening: The gate is not holding an open connection.
